description: Our own base images, ghcr.io/foreverworks/debian and ghcr.io/foreverworks/node, which foreverworks/debian-oci-images releases within about an hour of a Debian security snapshot that changes them.
In a repo that extends this preset, Renovate merges these two images' digest bumps, and tag bumps within the same line, on green CI at any hour, without waiting for the weekly schedule.
Renovate merges itself, never through GitHub's auto-merge, and only when every check on its branch has passed: a branch with no checks waits, and one red or pending check stops the merge.

packageRules.description: Every FROM line on these images stays pinned by digest, so each new release is a change Renovate can see.
A new base merges on its own once CI is green, at any hour, because it usually carries a security fix. A new major line (Debian 14, the next Node LTS) is not covered: it stays a PR.
prBodyNotes: A new release of our own base image (foreverworks/debian-oci-images). Renovate merges this PR once every check on it has passed. A red check stops it here for a person to look at.
